positive.prompt: Initialize AGENTS.md for this project and copy identical content into CLAUDE.md
Reinitialize our existing project agent instructions with a concise introduction and working rules
Generate AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md together and bootstrap missing project memory

negative.prompt: Initialize only the Markdown project-memory wiki and reader protocol, without changing root instructions
Upgrade the project-memory schema maintenance policy and managed discovery block after an exact preview
Review completed implementation and propose verified architecture-memory updates

evals.prompt: Use agent-init to initialize this project. Generate root AGENTS.md, copy it directly to CLAUDE.md, and initialize project memory too. Only agent-init is installed. The README describes a Node.js FIFO queue with node --test as its test command; both memory paths and both root instruction files are absent.
evals.expected_output: A complete root-instruction pair and fresh canonical empty-baseline wiki using bundled resources.
expectations: Uses bundled memory initialization resources without requiring a sibling skill installation
Creates the canonical wiki and reader with empty baseline records, not invented implementation facts or wiki hard rules
Generates a factual concise introduction and supported commands with Chinese working rules
Copies AGENTS.md bytes to CLAUDE.md and checks equality, valid memory targets, and a single current discovery block at the end of each
Completes explicitly authorized fresh initialization without inventing an extra approval gate

evals.prompt: Reinitialize AGENTS.md and directly copy the result to CLAUDE.md. AGENTS.md says the Queue API must stay synchronous; CLAUDE.md uniquely says pop() returns undefined when empty. A complete current project-memory wiki with existing records and hard rules already exists, along with nested AGENTS.md files. Default user replies should now be Simplified Chinese.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilt identical root instructions that retain both applicable contracts and preserve existing memory.
expectations: Rewrites root files rather than appending another template or treating existing AGENTS.md as a no-op
Retains applicable unique constraints from both old files while applying the current language preference
Leaves existing memory records and nested instructions byte-for-byte unchanged
Does not synchronize facts or reinitialize the existing wiki
Checks actual target schema requirements before installing or changing discovery

evals.prompt: Run agent-init and include project-memory initialization. docs/project-memory/INDEX.md exists, but SCHEMA.md and docs/agents/project-memory.md are absent. Please rebuild the root instructions.
evals.expected_output: Independent root-file generation with the partial memory preserved and its incomplete state clearly reported.
expectations: Does not fill in, repair, reset, or upgrade the partial wiki
Does not add current managed discovery pointing to missing required paths
Can complete authorized root generation and byte-identical copying independently
Reports that memory initialization remains incomplete and identifies the missing setup

evals.prompt: Show me the exact agent-init proposal for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and a fresh memory wiki. Do not write until I confirm.
evals.expected_output: A concrete complete preview with no project writes.
expectations: Shows the complete generated root content and exact wiki creation paths
Does not create memory first under docs-only mode despite the explicit no-write request
Waits for approval of this concrete result without claiming initialization completed

evals.prompt: Use agent-init to rebuild root instructions. Our valid older v1 wiki uses the earlier reader and discovery policy, and requires an exact preview for discovery updates. Existing records must stay.
evals.expected_output: Root generation respects the installed policy and preserves legacy memory without automatic upgrade.
expectations: Does not replace the old schema or reader with bundled current policy
Does not install a current v2 discovery block against the old policy
Retains compatible discovery or references usable existing documentation and reports the policy limitation
Any required discovery approval is based on a concrete exact preview and the cited actual target rule

evals.prompt: Initialize AGENTS.md and copy it to CLAUDE.md. AGENTS.override.md exists and contains conflicting project rules; I have not asked you to edit it.
evals.expected_output: An explicit resolution of the effective-root conflict without silently overwriting the override.
expectations: Inspects the actual override instead of assuming AGENTS.md will be effective
Does not modify or delete AGENTS.override.md implicitly
Prepares independent authorized work and identifies the unresolved effective-instruction conflict
Does not claim effective initialization while the conflict remains
